name: Asymmetric Tree SPIHT (AT-SPIHT)
definition: A lossless compression method for volumetric medical images that uses a 3-D reversible integer wavelet transform and a set partitioning in hierarchical tree (SPIHT) algorithm based on an asymmetric tree structure. It solves the problem of compressing huge volumetric data (CT/MR) by decorrelating slices and providing better compression than 2-D techniques or symmetric 3-D SPIHT.
